risks.risk: The item may not be a genuine M272 or may be a generic part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the side or back).

risks.risk: The internal gears may be stripped, damaged, or have excessive wear.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission being shifted through all gears.

risks.risk: The torque converter may leak or have internal damage.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the gearbox being shifted through all gears to check for damage.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
